ultraface_rfb_320.name: UltraFace RFB-320
ultraface_rfb_320.justification: UltraFace RFB-320 is an ultra-lightweight (<1.3 MB) face detector with high recall on varied scales, profiles, and occluded faces. MIT license allows fully unencumbered bundling and on-device execution.

paddleocr_det_v3.name: PaddleOCR DBNet v3 Detection
paddleocr_det_v3.justification: PaddleOCR DBNet v3 provides state-of-the-art bounding polygon and word box detection for dense documents and multi-script layouts including Latin and Devanagari. Apache-2.0 license.

yolox_nano.name: YOLOX-nano UI Detector
yolox_nano.justification: YOLOX-nano is an ultra-compact anchor-free detector (~3.6 MB) under the permissive Apache-2.0 license (Megvii-BaseDetection). Avoids AGPL copyleft obligations associated with YOLOv8/v11 and OmniParser. Perfect for on-device browser inference via ONNX Runtime Web.
